title: Memo Re The Debts Of John Sandor

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 25/000-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Headquarters Narcotic Section C.I. Station,
SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
V. D H 834
Date May 3 1933.

Subject (in full)............................................................ John Sandor

Made by.................... D.I. Papp ....................................Forwarded by........ Supt. Quayle

John Sandor, Hungarian, 26, arrived at Shanghai from
Budapest Hungary about 2 months ago. Although unemployed, he
has been occupying since his arrival a suite at Cathay Hotel.
He is reported to be a morphine addict and rather irresponsible
in behaviour. Since his arrival, he has incurred miscellaneous
debts, amounting to about $5,000.00 under various pretences from
different persons in Shanghai.
John Sandor's father who is reported to be a very
wealthy and influential business man at Budapest, has been
approached regarding his son's debts incurred at Shanghai, but,
it is understood, that he is unwilling to pay for same.

Continue on other
side.
（签名：Papp）
D. I.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / MAY 3 1933 / CRIME BRANCH）

D.C. (Crime)

（批：D.I. Papp）
Further report when developments arise
（签名：O. Quayle）
Supt
C.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总部缉毒科中央捕房，
秘密及机密报告
V. D H 834
日期：1933年5月3日。

事由（全称）............................................................ 约翰·桑多尔 (John Sandor)

呈报人.................... 副督察帕普 (D.I. Papp) .................................... 转呈人........ 巡官奎尔 (Supt. Quayle)

约翰·桑多尔，匈牙利籍，26岁，约于两个月前从匈牙利布达佩斯抵达上海。尽管失业，自抵沪以来一直入住华懋饭店 (Cathay Hotel) 的一套客房。据报其为吗啡成瘾者，行为颇不负责任。自抵沪以来，他以各种借口向上海不同人士招致杂项债务，总额约达5,000.00美元。
据报约翰·桑多尔之父是布达佩斯一位非常富有且具影响力的商人，已就其子在上海所欠债务与其联系，但据悉他不愿代为偿还。

续背面。
（签名：帕普）
副督察

（印：副总巡官 / 1933年5月3日 / 刑事科）

副总巡官（刑事科）

（批注：副督察帕普）
若有新进展再行报告
（签名：O. 奎尔）
巡官
中央捕房

日期 1933年5月9日
（刑事科）办公笔记

总巡官
这是我们关于桑德尔 (Sander) 的全部文件。我认为此事若向匈牙利领事提出并无益处。五月份授予的信贷额度使得以欺诈罪采取行动的可能性不复存在。看来在5月1日他欠款2,875.57美元，该数额至5月4日已增至3,132.63美元。所列项目显示其管理层在拍卖方面并无节制。

副总巡官
（刑事科）

SHANGHAI
CHINA

May 8th, 1933.

Major F.W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Commissioner,
Police Force,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
HANKOW ROAD.

RE: MR. JOHN SANDOR

Dear Major Gerrard:

I am enclosing for your information my entire file with reference to the above and am at a loss to know just exactly what action to take in this case and thought I would ask your advise.

The gentleman in question is reputed to be the son of a wealthy banker in Budapest, and while his father, as you will note from the last telegram received, being very much upset over the amount of credit given to his son states that Exchange export is legally prohibited.

The Mr. Hugo Sandor with whom we have had correspondence and who has helped us in sending the necessary cables is, I believe, a relation of Mr. John Sandor.

Thanking you very kindly in advance for any help you may give me in this matter, and regretting to trouble you, I remain,

With kindest regards,
Yours sincerely,

RT:M
GENERAL MANAGER.

总监，
警务处，
上海公共租界工部局，
汉口路。

事由：约翰·桑多尔先生

亲爱的杰拉德少校：

随函附上我处关于上述人士的全部档案供贵方参考，对于此案究竟应采取何种行动，我深感困惑，故特向阁下征询意见。

据悉，这位先生是布达佩斯一位富有银行家之子，正如阁下从收到的最新电报中所见，其父对给予其子的信贷额度之大深感不安，并声明外汇汇出在法律上是被禁止的。

与我们通信并协助我们发送必要电报的雨果·桑多尔 (Hugo Sandor) 先生，我相信是约翰·桑多尔先生的亲属。

提前衷心感谢阁下在此事上可能给予的任何帮助，并对打扰阁下表示歉意，此致

最诚挚的问候，
您真诚的，

RT:M
总经理
